name: Dr. Osei
bio: Knows every plant on Earth by sight. Has opinions about all of them. Does not like what is growing on the derelict.

passive_skill.description: Crop health events resolve more favorably. Crop water consumption reduced 15%.

active_skill.name: Greenhouse Protocol
active_skill.description: Stabilize a sick crop — restore 15 crop health. One use between stations.

name: Kazuki
bio: Fixes things. Eats twice as much. Nobody has asked why.

passive_skill.description: Event hull repairs land 25% further; REPAIR patches +10 hull more. Fabricator wear reduced by 20%.

active_skill.name: Emergency Patch
active_skill.description: Prevent 1 hull damage event between stations.

name: Dr. Vasquez
bio: Chronically anxious. Excellent at their job. Do not ask about their residency.

passive_skill.description: Severity rolls improved — injury instead of lethal more often. Injured crew recover faster.

severity_modifier.notes: 50% chance a lethal outcome downgrades to injury when medic is aboard (25% while wounded)

active_skill.name: Treatment
active_skill.description: Heal someone aboard who is injured — restore to healthy. One use between stations.

name: Lindqvist
bio: Overconfident. Statistically correct 78% of the time. Keeps a tally.

passive_skill.description: Fuel efficiency improved — engine burn reduced 10%.

active_skill.name: Push Engines
active_skill.description: Skip a node at double fuel cost. Sometimes you need to be somewhere else.

name: Reyes
bio: The most important person on the ship. They know it.

passive_skill.description: Food lasts longer — consumption reduced 15%. Passive morale +1 from actual meals.

active_skill.name: Special Meal
active_skill.description: Restore 10 morale using food reserves. Worth it.

name: Dr. Tanaka
bio: Deeply excited about everything that could kill them. This is either bravery or a problem.

passive_skill.description: Anomaly and alien events have additional safe options. Biological sample analysis available.

active_skill.name: Field Analysis
active_skill.description: Analyze one unknown biological item or specimen — reveals properties before committing. One use between stations.

name: Hargrove
bio: Absolutely useless in every situation except the one specific situation. That situation comes up more than you'd think.

passive_skill.description: Blunts the first enemy volley in a fight, and pirates give up sooner. They'd call it 'strategic patience.'

active_skill.name: Negotiation
active_skill.description: Unlock peaceful resolution in hostile/pirate events. Also occasionally talk stations into better deals.
